title: Cardinality of the hard-distribution sample space
statement: A hard sample over $n \ge 1$ coordinates consists of a distinguished coordinate $T \in \{0,1,\dots,n-1\}$, two bits $x_T, y_T \in \{0,1\}$, and an assignment giving each of the $n$ coordinates one of the three tags *neither*, *left only*, or *right only*. The number of such samples is exactly $n \cdot 4 \cdot 3^{n}$.
hypotheses_covered: n is a positive natural number
conclusion: the finite cardinality equals n * 4 * 3^n
replaced: Cardinality of the explicit hard-distribution sample space.
